subject: Application for Market/Business Research Analyst - Shivank Shukla
body:
Dear Hiring Team at Honhr,

I am a Research & Strategy Associate with one year of experience in market and business research, skilled in SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, ETL processes, data cleaning, and KPI reporting.

In my current role I have delivered actionable insights through dashboards and reports, supporting stakeholders in data‑driven decision making.

My portfolio showcasing relevant projects is available at https://shivank-shukla-portfolio.vercel.app/, and my code repositories are at https://github.com/shukla009.

I am available to join after a one‑month notice period and have attached my resume for your review.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Honhr’s research initiatives.

Best regards,
Shivank Shukla
